details.jobDescription:
At ENGIE, we believe data powers smarter decisions and accelerates the energy transition. Within Global Business Services (GBS), we handle massive volumes of operational data across every support function. We are building a dedicated GBS Data Engine, and we need you to shape it.︁︀​︂︀︀​︁︂︉​︇︉

As our Data Expert, you will transform raw data into meaningful business insights. You will own the full data value chain, from ingestion to visualization, and serve as a technical mentor for the team. Your work directly supports Finance, Procurement, HR, and IT operations at a global scale.
What You'll Do
- Deliver end-to-end data solutions from ingestion through transformation to insightful dashboards and reports for business stakeholders.
- Design, build, and maintain automated data pipelines and datasets using modern lakehouse architectures on AWS and Microsoft Fabric.
- Develop compelling Power BI visualizations and proactively propose data-driven insights that create tangible business value.
- Act as the technical single point of contact for your data solutions, ensuring quality, performance, and lifecycle management.
- Drive automation across all data workflows to reduce manual effort and optimize cost-effectiveness from day one.
- Ensure compliance with cybersecurity, data privacy, data governance, SecOps, and FinOps operating models across the GBS organization.
- Continuously improve solution architectures, tooling, and processes while mentoring team members on best practices.
What You Bring
- Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Minimum 10 years of hands-on experience delivering data solutions with demonstrated business impact.
- Strong expertise in AWS data services, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse, pipelines, semantic models), and Power BI (DAX, Power Query, M language).
- Solid proficiency in Python, SQL, and automation tools such as Power Automate.
- Working knowledge of Collibra, Informatica IDMC, CI/CD processes, GitHub, Jira, and AI-assisted development tools.
- Previous experience in an international environment and familiarity with agile methodologies.
- Excellent communication skills in English; French is a plus. You are autonomous, results-driven, collaborative, and eager to learn.
Location
Hybrid working arrangement combining on-site collaboration and remote flexibility.
What We Offer
- A competitive salary package aligned with your senior expertise and career ambitions.
- A diversity of missions across Finance, Procurement, HR, IT, and more within a global organization.
- Stimulating, high-impact work at the heart of ENGIE's data transformation journey.
- A friendly, collaborative work environment where initiative and creativity are valued.
- Flexibility and strong work-life balance through our hybrid model.
- Continuous learning opportunities with access to cutting-edge data technologies and AI tools.
Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.
If you decide to send us your personal information in order to apply for this position, please be aware of our job candidate GDPR Data Privacy Notice: https://www.engie.ro/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/ER_Nota-de-informare-Candidati.pdf.
Our Commitment
At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of the adventure of the century!
ENGIE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants based on their skills, experience, and potential. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or any other protected characteristic.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process. If you need any adjustments, please let us know and we will support you.

Despre ENGIE Romania

Grupul ENGIE este o referință globală în domeniul energiei și al serviciilor cu emisii reduse de carbon. Alături de cei 4.250 de angajați din România, de clienți, parteneri și părți interesate, ne angajăm să accelerăm tranziția către o economie cu impact neutru în ceea ce privește emisiile de carbon, printr-un consum redus de energie și soluții prietenoase cu mediul. Inspirați de ambiția noastră, îmbinăm performanța economică cu producerea unui impact pozitiv asupra oamenilor și planetei, bazându-ne pe activitățile noastre cheie – gaze naturale, energie electrică, servicii tehnice – pentru a oferi soluții competitive clienților noștri.
